title: Fully sequential Gaussian process regression for preference learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19391v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study continuous global optimization problems in which the objective function cannot be directly evaluated; rather, we observe only which of two selected design points appears to perform better, subject to noise. Such comparisons complicate the use of Gaussian process regression because they yield non-Gaussian posteriors. We consider a fully sequential approximation, based on moment-matching, that yields a fast closed-form update of the metamodel's mean and covariance. We then propose DOVE, a fully sequential sampling policy that combines an information gain criterion with randomized sampling designed to control error accumulation. Under fairly standard regularity conditions, we prove convergence rates for both statistical error and expected simple regret that depend on kernel smoothness. To our knowledge, these are the first such rates for fully sequential approximate Bayesian inference in continuous global optimization.

translated_title: 面向偏好学习的完全序贯高斯过程回归
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类连续全局优化问题，其目标函数无法被直接评估；相反，我们只能观测到在两个选定的设计点中哪一个（在有噪声的情况下）表现更好。这类成对比较会使高斯过程回归的使用变得复杂，因为其会产生非高斯后验。我们考虑一种基于矩匹配的完全序贯近似方法，该方法可以对元模型的均值和协方差实现快速的闭式更新。随后我们提出了DOVE，这是一种完全序贯采样策略，它将信息增益准则与旨在控制误差累积的随机采样相结合。在相当标准的正则性条件下，我们证明了依赖于核函数光滑性的统计误差和期望简单遗憾的收敛速率。据我们所知，这是连续全局优化领域中完全序贯近似贝叶斯推断的首个此类收敛速率结果。
tldr: 该论文针对目标函数只能通过带噪声成对比较来评估的连续全局优化问题，提出了基于矩匹配的完全序贯高斯过程近似方法DOVE，并首次为这类完全序贯近似贝叶斯推断建立了统计误差和期望简单遗憾的收敛速率保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DOVE, a fully sequential moment-matching-based Gaussian process approximation for continuous global optimization with only noisy pairwise comparisons, and establishes the first convergence rate guarantees for statistical error and expected simple regret of fully sequential approximate Bayesian inference in this setting.
